integrity: The all-dimensional proof uses a complete sign-partition Cauchy-Schwarz minimization. Finite exact and numerical checks are supplemental. Originality is evaluated against specifically inspected literature only, without claims of global priority or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact threshold and all equality directions only for central congruent planks with a fixed regular-simplex normal frame, \(d\ge2\); no optimization among translated or differently directed planks. The source 2026 preprint could be checked bibliographically and by abstract but not through its full manuscript. The odd-dimensional equimodular subcase and the planar three-zone threshold have independent prior coverage; the original component is the higher even-dimensional classification.
title: Parity-sharp covering threshold for simplex-normal planks
